title: Implement CLI skeleton and venv bootstrap
description: Create memory.py with the shebang line, the _bootstrap() function that creates .venv/ and installs onnxruntime, sqlite-vec, tokenizers, and numpy, and a minimal argparse skeleton that parses the init and add subcommands (stubs only — no logic yet). Mark the file executable.
acceptance_criteria: memory.py has shebang #!/usr/bin/env python3 on line 1
_bootstrap() creates .venv/ and installs the four deps on first run
_bootstrap() is a no-op when already running inside the managed venv
Running ./memory.py --help does not error and lists init and add subcommands
Running ./memory.py with an unknown subcommand exits non-zero
